The '''battle''' at [[Tolea Biqua]] on [[Genarius]] was set shortly after the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], between the forces of the [[Coalition]] and the [[Cularin Militia]]. The battle was ended when the Militia was able to destroy the Coalition's [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|Lucrehulk-class battleship]], rendering the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] uninhabitable in the proccess.
